svg.title: A storeroom at Toronto Union
svg.desc: A railway storeroom with shelves and nine grey boxes, one open with comment cards spilling out, and two people standing in front of it with a platform visible through the window.

g.text: Fourteen things to find. Eight boxes have a year on them. The ninth has nothing, and it is the fullest.
the table, and one card on it
the ninth box, with no year on it
the open box - cards spilling out of it
the only cup in a room of paper
the marketing manager - a report due Friday
